name: Third-Person Mode
author: AnlionGamer
description: Adds a toggleable, collision-aware third-person camera while preserving vanilla player-authoritative world and ranged targeting for Castle Miner Z gameplay.
releaseNotes: Third-Person Mode 1.0.1 fixes third-person crosshair fidelity: hip-fire guns, grenades, tools, blocks, melee, and other world-interaction items now reuse CMZ 1.9.9.8 CrossHairTick visuals and vanilla spread/brightness rules at the projected real-aim point. The compact + remains exclusive to non-scoped gun ADS, while scoped guns continue to use the native first-person scope. Camera, collision, targeting, hotkey, and scope-state architecture are otherwise unchanged.
multiplayer: Client-side camera and HUD behavior; no custom network messages. Multiplayer compatibility remains unverified.

configSchema.label: Toggle Camera Hotkey
configSchema.description: Default: C. Enter a key such as C or F5, or a chord such as Ctrl+C, Alt+C, or Shift+C. Modifier-only bindings are rejected and invalid values fall back to C.

configSchema.label: Starting Perspective
configSchema.description: Perspective used when entering a gameplay session.

configSchema.label: Camera Side
configSchema.description: Places the third-person camera over the right shoulder, centered, or over the left shoulder.

configSchema.label: Camera Distance
configSchema.description: Third-person camera distance behind the player.

configSchema.label: Camera Height
configSchema.description: Vertical offset from the normal eye line.
